fields.name: Apple MacBook Pro 16" M3 Max
fields.description: Top-tier MacBook Pro featuring Apple Silicon M3 Max, Liquid Retina XDR display, and supreme battery life.
fields.short_description: Apple Silicon M3 Max workstation powerhouse.

fields.name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro
fields.description: Flagship iPhone featuring Aerospace-grade titanium design, A17 Pro chip, and advanced 48MP camera system.
fields.short_description: Forged in titanium, powered by A17 Pro.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
fields.description: Galaxy AI powerhouse with Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, titanium armor, and embedded S-Pen.
fields.short_description: Epic Galaxy AI smartphone with titanium design.

fields.name: Nike Air Max 270
fields.description: Legendary lifestyle sneakers featuring Nike's biggest heel Air unit yet for a super-soft ride.
fields.short_description: Bold comfort meets modern streetwear icon.

fields.name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max
fields.description: iPhone 15 Pro Max — Apple kompaniyasining eng kuchli flagmani. 6.7 dyuymli Super Retina XDR ProMotion ekrani, eng yangi A17 Pro protsessori hamda 48MP periskopli kamera tizimi bilan professional suratga olish imkonini beradi.
fields.short_description: Titan korpus, 5x optik zoom va A17 Pro qudratli chipi.

fields.name: Apple iPhone 15
fields.description: Yangi iPhone 15 barcha kundalik vazifalar uchun universal tanlov. Rangli mat orqa oyna, Dynamic Island qulay bildirishnomalari va A16 Bionic protsessori.
fields.short_description: Dynamic Island, 48MP asosiy kamera va zamonaviy USB-C porti.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5
fields.description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 5 — cho'ntagingizdagi to'liq quvvatli planshet. Flex Hinge yangi ilmog'i orqali tirqishsiz yopiladi, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy esa eng og'ir ilovalarni bir vaqtda boshqaradi.
fields.short_description: Bukiluvchi ulkan 7.6 dyuymli ekran va multitasking flagmani.

fields.name: Xiaomi 14 Ultra
fields.description: Xiaomi 14 Ultra fotograflar va texnologiya ixlosmandlari uchun yaratilgan. Leica optikasi, o'zgaruvchan diafragma (f/1.63 - f/4.0), Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 va 90W tezkor zaryadlash.
fields.short_description: Leica Summilux professional 1-dyuymli 4 kamerali fotoflagman.

fields.name: Google Pixel 8 Pro
fields.description: Google Tensor G3 chipi, Magic Editor, Best Take va 7 yillik to'liq Android yangilanish kafolati bilan Google eng kuchli aqlli smartfoni.
fields.short_description: Google AI kuchiga ega sof Android va ajoyib fototizim.

fields.name: Apple MacBook Air 15" M3
fields.description: MacBook Air 15 dyuymli katta ekranga ega bo'lishiga qaramay juda yengil va nozik. Ventilatorsiz mutlaqo sokin ishlaydi, 18 soatlik avtonom quvvat esa kun bo'yi zaryadsiz ishlash imkonini beradi.
fields.short_description: Yupqa alyuminiy korpus, 15.3" Liquid Retina va M3 chipi.

fields.name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 (2024)
fields.description: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 — zamonaviy o'yinlar va 3D modellashtirish uchun ultra yengil flagman noutbuk. Intel Core Ultra 9, ROG Nebula OLED ekrani hamda Slash Lighting zamonaviy dizayni.
fields.short_description: RTX 4080 grafikasi va 2.5K 240Hz OLED ekranli geymerlik qudrati.

fields.name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12
fields.description: ThinkPad X1 Carbon — jahon korporativ dunyosining eng ishonchli ultrabuki. 1.09 kg engil og'irlik, afsonaviy klaviatura, TrackPoint va MIL-SPEC harbiy chidamlilik standarti.
fields.short_description: Biznes etaloni, uglerod tolali engil korpus va 2.8K OLED ekran.

fields.name: Dell XPS 15 (9530)
fields.description: Dell XPS 15 — video montajchilar, grafik dizaynerlar va ijodkorlar uchun mukammal noutbuk. CNC alyuminiy korpus, uglerod tolali kaft tayanchi va yuqori rang aniqligi.
fields.short_description: InfinityEdge 3.5K OLED sensorli ekran va Intel Core i9 quvvati.

fields.name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
fields.description: Sony WH-1000XM5 ikki protsessorli faol shovqin to'xtatish (ANC) texnologiyasi, LDAC yuqori aniqlikdagi audio kodeki va nafis yumshoq charmli korpusga ega.
fields.short_description: Sanoatdagi eng ilg'or faol shovqinni so'ndirish va 30 soatlik tinglash.

fields.name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Gen, USB-C)
fields.description: AirPods Pro 2 adaptiv audio, ovozni shaxsiylashtirilgan fazoviy eshittirish (Spatial Audio) va kutilmagan suhbatlarda avtomatik ovoz pasaytirish funksiyalariga ega.
fields.short_description: H2 chipi, 2x kuchliroq shovqin so'ndirish va USB-C MagSafe g'ilof.

fields.name: Apple AirPods Max
fields.description: Apple AirPods Max to'liq o'lchamli quloqchinlarida dinamik drayverlar har bir tovush nuansini boricha ifodalaydi. Nafas oluvchi to'rli boshbog' bosimni teng taqsimlaydi.
fields.short_description: Hi-Fi akustika, hisob-kitobli audio va premium zanglamas po'lat.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy Buds2 Pro
fields.description: Samsung Galaxy Buds2 Pro — Galaxy ekotizimidagi eng yaxshi simsiz quloqchin. Shamolga qarshi aerodinamik korpus va tiniq qo'ng'iroqlar.
fields.short_description: 24-bit Hi-Fi audio, 360 Audio va ergonomik qulay dizayn.

fields.name: JBL Charge 5 Portable Speaker
fields.description: JBL Charge 5 sayrlar, hovuz bo'yi va tabiat qo'ynidagi bazmlar uchun ideal. Alohida tvitter va ikkita passiv radiator kuchli chuqur bas beradi, o'rnatilgan powerbank esa telefoningizni quvvatlaydi.
fields.short_description: Kuchli JBL Original Pro baslari, IP67 himoya va 20 soatlik quvvat.

fields.name: Marshall Emberton II
fields.description: Marshall Emberton II o'ziga xos vintage rok-n-roll dizayni, silikon mustahkam korpusi va 360 darajali keng fazoviy ovoz tarqatish qobiliyati bilan ajralib turadi.
fields.short_description: 360° True Stereophonic tovush va 30+ soatlik avtonom quvvat.

fields.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
fields.description: Ekstremal sportchilar, sayyohlar va faol hayot tarzi egalari uchun yaratilgan. Ikki chastotali aniq GPS, sho'ng'ish kompyuteri va 72 soatlik kam quvvat rejimi.
fields.short_description: 49mm titan korpus, 3000 nitli eng yorqin ekran va S9 SiP chipi.

fields.name: Apple Watch Series 9
fields.description: Apple Watch Series 9 kunlik salomatlik, EKG, qondagi kislorod miqdori va jismoniy faollikni kuzatishda eng yaxshi yordamchingiz.
fields.short_description: Double Tap jest boshqaruvi, S9 protsessor va doimiy salomatlik nazorati.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Classic
fields.description: Galaxy Watch 6 Classic an'anaviy hashamatli soat ko'rinishini ilg'or aqlli funksiyalar bilan birlashtiradi. Zanglamas po'lat, tana tarkibi tahlili va yurak ritmi monitoringi.
fields.short_description: Aylanuvchi mexanik bezel, safir shisha va uyqu murabbiyligi.

fields.name: Xiaomi Smart Band 8 Pro
fields.description: Smart Band 8 Pro katta to'rtburchak displey, mustaqil yo'ldosh navigatsiyasi va 150 dan ortiq sport rejimlari bilan arzon va qulay bilaguzuk.
fields.short_description: Katta 1.74" AMOLED ekran, GNSS GPS va 14 kunlik batareya.

fields.name: Apple iPad Pro 13" M4
fields.description: Yangi iPad Pro dunyodagi eng ilg'or Ultra Retina XDR ikki qatlamli OLED displeyi va Apple M4 chipi bilan qurollangan. Ilhomlantiruvchi ijod va professional ish stansiyasi.
fields.short_description: Ultra Retina XDR Tandem OLED ekrani, M4 chipi va faqat 5.1mm qalinlik.

fields.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 Ultra
fields.description: Galaxy Tab S9 Ultra ulkan ekran, o'rnatilgan qulay S Pen elektron qalami, Dex kompyuter rejimi hamda suv va changdan to'liq IP68 himoyaga ega.
fields.short_description: Ulkan 14.6" Dynamic AMOLED 2X ekran, IP68 suvdan himoya va S Pen.

fields.name: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim
fields.description: PlayStation 5 Slim 1TB o'rnatilgan SSD xotira, yangilangan ixcham korpus va immersiv haptic taktil qaytarish bilan eng zamonaviy o'yin tajribasini taqdim etadi.
fields.short_description: Tezkor SSD, 4K 120Hz o'yinlar va DualSense innovatsion kontrolleri.

fields.name: Nike Air Force 1 '07
fields.description: Nike Air Force 1 '07 — barcha zamonlarning eng ommabop krossovkasi. Chidamli tikilgan charm qoplamalar, toza oq rang va qulay amortizatsiya.
fields.short_description: Afsonaviy shahar krossovkasi, qalin charm ustki qism va Nike Air qulayligi.

fields.name: Adidas Samba OG
fields.description: 1950-yillardan buyon o'z jozibasini yo'qotmagan afsona. Gum rezina taglik, T shaklidagi zamsh burun qismi va kontrast 3 tasma.
fields.short_description: Afsonaviy retro krossovka, tabiiy charm va zamsh qoplama.

fields.name: Adidas Ultraboost Light
fields.description: Ultraboost Light avvalgi avlodlarga qaraganda 30% engilroq BOOST materialiga ega. Continental rezina taglik har qanday havoda ishonchli ushlaydi.
fields.short_description: Eng engil Light BOOST materiali, cheksiz energiya qaytarish.

fields.name: Puma RS-X Reinvention
fields.description: Puma RS-X o'zgacha zamonaviy retro estetika va qulay Running System texnologiyasiga ega yorqin krossovka.
fields.short_description: Massiv retro siluet va Running System qulay amortizatsiyasi.

fields.name: Nike Sportswear Club Fleece Hoodie
fields.description: Nike Sportswear Club Fleece xudisi sovuq kunlarda issiq va qulay saqlaydi. Ko'krakdagi kashta Nike logotipi va qulay keng cho'ntak.
fields.short_description: Klassik paxtali xudi, yumshoq ichki fleece va qulay bichim.

fields.name: Adidas Essentials 3-Stripes Tracksuit
fields.description: Sport bilan shug'ullanish va dam olish kunlari uchun afsonaviy Adidas sport libosi. Qulay elastik kamar va nafas oluvchi material.
fields.short_description: Klassik 3 tasma chiziqli sport kostyumi, zamokli jaket va shim.

fields.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute
fields.description: Dyson V15 Detect chang zarralarini hisoblovchi pyezo datchik va chang miqdoriga qarab tortish kuchini avtomatik sozlovchi intellektual changyutgich.
fields.short_description: Yashirin changni ko'rsatuvchi lazer nuri va 240 AW kuchli tortish.

fields.name: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X10+
fields.description: Xiaomi Robot Vacuum X10+ polni changdan tozalaydi, latasini o'zi yuvadi va issiq havo bilan quritadi. S-Cross AI 3D to'siqlarni aylanib o'tish tizimi.
fields.short_description: O'z-o'zini tozalash va yuvish stansiyali avtonom robot changyutgich.

fields.name: De'Longhi Magnifica S Smart Coffee Machine
fields.description: De'Longhi Magnifica S yangi yanchilgan donalardan Italiya sifatidagi espresso va mayin kremli kapuchino tayyorlaydi. 13 darajali po'lat tegirmon.
fields.short_description: Donador qahvadan yangi espresso va kapuchino tayyorlovchi avtomat.

fields.alt_text: MacBook Pro 16 Space Gray Front View
De'Longhi Magnifica S Smart Coffee Machine

fields.comment: Xaridingiz va batafsil fikr-mulohazangiz uchun minnatdorchilik bildiramiz!

fields.title: Ajoyib noutbuk, dasturlash uchun ideal!
fields.comment: M3 Max protsessori va 16GB operativ xotirasi barcha og'ir vazifalarni juda tez bajaradi. Batareyasi ham 18 soatgacha yetadi. Tavsiya qilaman.

fields.title: Kamera va korpus a'lo darajada
fields.comment: Titan korpusi juda yengil va qulay. Kamerasi tungi vaqtda ham tiniq suratga oladi.
fields.cons: Batareya quvvati bir kunga yetadi xolos

fields.title: Juda qulay krossovka
fields.comment: Yugurish va kundalik kiyish uchun juda mos. Oyoqda juda yumshoq turadi.

fields.title: Katta va og'ir
fields.comment: Noutbuk kuchi zo'r, lekin ryukzakda olib yurishga biroz og'irlik qildi.

fields.title: Eng yaxshi kamera!
fields.comment: Telefon nihoyatda tez ishlaydi, titan korpus tufayli avvalgilariga qaraganda ancha yengil.

fields.title: Mukammal smartfon
fields.comment: Batareyasi bemalol 1.5 kunga yetadi, displey 120Hz oqim kabi tekis.

fields.title: Qulay va ixcham
fields.comment: USB-C nihoyat qo'shilgani juda yaxshi bo'ldi, endi hamma qurilmaga bir kabel yetadi.

fields.title: Ish uchun tengsiz
fields.comment: Bir vaqtning o'zida 3 ta ilovani ochib ishlash mumkin. Ekran sifati ajoyib.

fields.title: Haqiqiy fotoapparat
fields.comment: Suratlari shunchaki fantastik, ayniqsa tunda va portret rejimida.

fields.title: AI imkoniyatlari hayratlanarli
fields.comment: Fotolarni tahrirlash sun'iy intellekt orqali juda qulay.

fields.title: Mukammal ishchi noutbuk
fields.comment: Dasturlash va ofis ishlari uchun ideal, batareyasi hech qachon pand bermaydi.

fields.title: O'yinlar uchun monstr
fields.comment: Cyberpunk 2077 ultra sozlamalarda yugurib ketadi. OLED displey ranglari shunchaki aql bovar qilmas darajada to'yingan.

fields.title: Eng qulay klaviatura
fields.comment: Matn terish va biznes sayohatlar uchun bundan yaxshiroq noutbuk yo'q.

fields.title: Dizayn va kuch uyg'unligi
fields.comment: 4K video montajda Premiere Pro juda tez render qiladi.

fields.title: Shovqindan butkul uzilish
fields.comment: Samolyotda yoki gavjum ofisda shovqinni nol darajaga tushirib beradi.

fields.title: Har kungi ajralmas hamroh
fields.comment: Quloqda juda mahkam va sezilarsiz turadi, baslari nihoyatda tiniq.

fields.title: Premial ovoz sifati
fields.comment: Film ko'rishda xuddi kinoteatrdagi kabi effekt beradi.

fields.title: Juda qulay
fields.comment: Quloqda juda mustahkam o'tiradi, yugurishda ham tushib ketmaydi.

fields.title: Baslari aqlbovar qilmas
fields.comment: Ochiq havoda ham ovozi juda baland va tiniq yangraydi.

fields.title: Dizayn va musiqiy lazzat
fields.comment: Stol ustida ajoyib ko'rinadi, rok va klassik musiqalarni ajoyib ijro etadi.

fields.title: Eng chidamli soat
fields.comment: Tog'larda navigatsiya va sport bilan shug'ullanishda tengi yo'q.

fields.title: Double tap ajoyib
fields.comment: Qo'lingiz band bo'lsa ham barmoqlarni ikki marta tekkizib qo'ng'iroqqa javob berish juda qulay.

fields.title: Klassik va juda qulay
fields.comment: Aylanuvchi bezeli orqali menyuni boshqarish sensorli ekranga qaraganda ancha yoqimli.

fields.title: Narxiga nisbatan ajoyib
fields.comment: Batareyasi deyarli 2 hafta bemalol yetadi, bildirishnomalar katta ekranda yaxshi o'qiladi.

fields.title: OLED displey shunchaki mo'jiza
fields.comment: Ranglar chuqurligi, yupqaligi va M4 tezligi hayratga soladi.

fields.title: Rasm chizish va kino ko'rish uchun 1-raqam
fields.comment: S Pen qalami bepul qutidan chiqishi juda yoqimli. Ekran esa televizordek katta.
fields.cons: Kattaligi sababli bir qo'lda ushlash qiyin

fields.title: O'yin olamidagi cho'qqi
fields.comment: Yuklanish vaqti soniyalar ichida sodir bo'ladi, DualSense triggerlari hissi ajoyib.

fields.title: Universal uslub
fields.comment: Har qanday kiyim bilan mos tushadi, juda mustahkam.

fields.title: Trenddagi poyabzal
fields.comment: Jinsi va shimlar bilan ajoyib yarashadi, oyoqda engil turadi.

fields.title: Yugurish uchun tengsiz
fields.comment: Amortizatsiyasi bulut ustida yurgandek his beradi. Oyoq umuman charchamaydi.

fields.title: Juda chiroyli dizayn
fields.comment: Yorqin ranglari bilan ko'chada darhol e'tibor tortadi.

fields.title: Sifatli mato
fields.comment: Yuvilgandan keyin ham rangi o'chmaydi, ichki qismi yumshoq.

fields.title: Ajoyib kostyum
fields.comment: Materiali yengil, harakatlanishga hech xalal bermaydi.

fields.title: Tozalikning yangi bosqichi
fields.comment: Lazer nuri gilam va poldagi ko'rinmas changlarni ko'rsatganda hayratda qoldim.

fields.title: Haqiqiy ozodlik
fields.comment: 1 oy davomida umuman qo'l tekkizmadim, o'zi tozalab, stansiyaga axlatini to'kib qo'yadi.

fields.title: Har tong xushbo'y qahva
fields.comment: Kofeshopdagi kabi ajoyib kapuchino qiladi. Tozalash va ishlatish juda oson.
